name: Tooyama Masae
source:
Yukari's mother. The very person who taught Yukari various techniques. Her body, radiating an ageless, mature allure, remains in fine form.

She's quite the airhead, yet surprisingly sharp at times. A good confidante to Toshiya, she offers sincere advice whenever needed.

She believes improving one's sexual technique is proof of love for one's partner.

[From [url=http://www.ps-web.net/tryset/A002/03_chara.html]official site[/url]]
